primary_objective: Recover V0.11 unsupported business-rule candidates through reusable semantic-capability extensions.
primary_metric_definition: Number of the frozen 38 V0.11 unsupported candidates that become CERTIFIED_A1 or CERTIFIED_A2 under V0.12 divided by 38.
regression_rule: Every V0.11 certified candidate must remain certified or receive an explicit regression diagnosis.
anti_bias_rules: The frozen V0.11 cohort cannot change.
V0.11 terminal outcomes cannot be rewritten.
No candidate may be removed after observing V0.12 results.
Recovery must result from a reusable semantic capability rather than a candidate-specific exception.
Every recovered candidate requires replayable evidence.
A failed recovery remains visible in the V0.12 ledger.
New external validation remains separate from the frozen V0.11 recovery cohort.
